doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI - Technical Context
doc.snippet: Defines conversation API endpoints: GET/POST /api/conversations, GET/DELETE/PATCH /api/conversations/{id}, GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages. Includes authentication flow via Cloudflare Access JWT and user_id mapping.

doc.title: Epic: Annie Web UI
doc.snippet: 1.5 day estimate. Lists endpoints for conversation management. CORS configuration for web UI domain. Rate limiting per user. OpenAPI documentation auto-generated.

doc.title: Project Documentation
doc.snippet: FastAPI (Python 3.12+) backend handling chat requests, LLM integration, state management. Uses Redis for state management and session storage. Key endpoints include POST /api/chat, GET /api/stream/{conversation_id}.

artifact.reason: Existing router pattern to follow. Shows session/conversation management via StateManager, Pydantic models for request/response, and error handling patterns.
Core state management module. Story extends StateManager with conversation-specific CRUD operations. Uses Redis keys: session:{user_id}, conversation:{id}, conversation_mapping:{id}.
FastAPI app entry point. Shows how to register routers, add CORS middleware, and exception handlers. Update this to register conversations router.
Existing Pydantic model pattern to follow. Shows validation, field_validator decorators, and utility functions.
Module init where new conversation.py models should be exported.
Test fixtures for backend tests. Shows environment variable mocking and Redis mock patterns.

dependencies.notes: No new dependencies required. Story uses existing packages.

constraints.constraint: Depends on Story 20.13: Cloudflare auth middleware must be in place for user_id resolution
Backward compatibility with existing session/conversation data (session:{user_id}, conversation:{id})
Redis key structure must follow existing patterns: conversations:{user_id} (sorted set), conversation:{id}:meta (hash)
Messages stored in existing conversation:{id}:messages list
CORS must allow annie.memoryforge.io and localhost:3000
Unit tests must cover all endpoints with success and error scenarios
Use existing StateManager patterns, don't create separate state class
Validate user owns conversation before any operation (403 for unauthorized access)
Rate limiting at 60 requests/minute per user

interface.signature: async def update_conversation_title(conversation_id: str, title: str) -> ConversationMeta

tests.standards: Testing uses pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Tests should mock Redis using the mock_redis fixture from conftest.py. Environment variables are automatically mocked. FastAPI TestClient used for endpoint testing. Each test file should be named test_{module}.py and placed in backend/tests/.
